label: Rectilinear distance and the MST
subgoals: Compute Manhattan distances between all pin pairs
Build a minimum spanning tree on those distances
Compare its length with the half-perimeter lower bound

label: Prim's algorithm on pins
subgoals: Start the tree at one pin
Add the shortest edge from the tree to an outside pin
Update each outside pin's distance to the tree after every step

label: What the MST estimate is good for
section: What the MST estimate is good for
subgoals: Use the MST as a length estimate for nets with four or more pins
Use its topology for pre-route delay estimates
Bound the MST by 3/2 of the Steiner minimum
